title: PHP releases on hold
content:
As on the php.internals mailing list, a pair of were made in the PHP source code repository over the weekend. The investigation into the root cause and exact scope of the compromise is still ongoing, therefore releases will be put on hold for two weeks assuming no further issues are discovered. announcedmaliciouscommitsThese commits were immediately noticed and reverted, and thus .never reached end users

Thank you for bearing with us while we endeavor to ensure that PHP is a stable and reliable platform for web development.
author: PHP.net news & announcements
